content.text:
The problem was a one-character-class typo in `site/css/tokens.css:5`:

```css
src: url('../font/acme-sans.woff2') format('woff2');
```

The font actually lives in `site/fonts/` (plural), so every page's `@font-face` failed to load and the whole site silently fell back to the system sans-serif. That changed text metrics everywhere — headline sizes, wrapping, spacing, and page heights — which is why every page looked "off."

I changed the path to `../fonts/acme-sans.woff2`. Both suites now pass:

- functional: 16/16 passed
- visual: 12/12 passed (all six pages at desktop and phone size, matching the approved screenshots)

No other regressions were present — the visual snapshots matched exactly after the font loaded.

STATUS: DONE
